query_wording: What implementation bottlenecks does the latest reporting identify, and which actions are assigned to the government or the Bank?

placeholders.reason: The query assumes a project; it is named in the turn. No aide-memoire is public, so the latest reporting is the ISR plus the 2026 restructuring paper.

turns.user: For P176619, what implementation bottlenecks does the latest reporting identify, and which actions are assigned to the government or the Bank?

expected_sources.role: Restructuring paper: implementation status, bottlenecks and agreed changes

text: Latest reporting: ISR seq. 8 (15 June 2026), whose narrative only notes moderate improvement in implementation and procurement, consultancy contracts awarded and key contracts expected in 2026 (ISR p. 2), and the restructuring paper of 27 March 2026, which sets out the bottlenecks. No aide-memoire is publicly disclosed for this project.

Bottlenecks (restructuring paper pp. 6-7): no detailed designs at appraisal, so design-and-supervision consultants had to be hired before small works contracts, delaying works; very low disbursement - US$11.3 million in total and US$13 million committed under contracts after more than two years; PBC results achieved but not yet verified for disbursement; slow procurement of energy-efficiency investments because of capacity constraints; MWI's limited procurement and financial management capacity for drought and water allocation activities; implementation rated Moderately Unsatisfactory since July 2025.

Actions by the government side: three sub-projects shifted to design-build contracts at the MTR (September 2025); award of the remaining design-and-supervision contracts (expected by May 2026) and of a technical assistance firm for all implementers (start expected March 2026) (p. 6); WAJ takes over procurement and contract management for sub-component 3.1 from MWI, with MWI certifying deliverables, and the POM is updated (pp. 7, 9); PBCs streamlined, with broader eligible expenditures and verification by the Jordan Audit Bureau (pp. 7-9); US$12 million moved from Component 2 to NRW reduction (p. 7); indicator targets aligned with the selected sub-projects (pp. 9-10).

Bank actions: Hands-on Extended Implementation Support for procurement and environmental and social risk management since May 2025 (p. 6); the team will recommend upgrading the implementation rating once most design-and-supervision contracts and the technical assistance contract are awarded (p. 7).
The restructuring paper projects that, without further major delays, all sub-projects finish by 30 June 2028 (p. 6). Neither document gives a dated action table like an aide-memoire would.

right_sources: Uses the latest ISR and the March 2026 restructuring paper (the fullest recent account).
grounded: Each bottleneck and action is cited to the document and page; no invented deadlines or responsibilities.
complete: Gives the main bottlenecks and separates actions by the government/implementing agencies from Bank actions.
scoped: Says which documents and dates the answer reflects and that no aide-memoire or action table is public.

notes: A newer ISR or a disclosed aide-memoire would change 'latest reporting'.
